subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar add a first-class quota gate, and should its MVP restrict providers to verified session/weekly lanes or expose provider-derived lane identifiers?
rationale: This choice defines a durable automation API across heterogeneous provider quota models and cannot be resolved safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Approve a narrow verified MVP
options.body: Restrict or derive supported quota lanes, document the contract, and require complete live proof before merge.

options.title: Approve generic window aliases
options.body: Treat every provider's primary and secondary windows as public `session` and `weekly` aliases despite differing provider semantics.

options.title: Keep usage output composable
options.body: Decline the new command and leave automation to callers consuming the existing machine-readable usage output.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow verified MVP
recommendation.body: Restrict or derive supported quota lanes, document the contract, and require complete live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal explicitly directs the product-contract decision to the repository owner.
